title: Aromatic Asian Chinese Tofu Noodles
description: A sour and creamy Chinese dish featuring vegan white wine vinegar and bhuna, served in a copper mug, this festive recipe is low-glycemic-friendly and perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the bhuna spice mix and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the noodles and cook according to package instructions, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vegan white wine vinegar and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Pour the vinegar mixture over the noodles and tofu, and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a copper mug and garnish with scallions and sesame seeds.
